checks: Origin rollout keeps TenOps on Qwen while TenDev has the read-only agent
Terra transport reserves before every call, settles actual usage and restores across new instances without inference
Spending denial invokes Qwen without any paid dispatch and uses the same authorized conversation

Read-only tool discovery cannot expose invoice, catalog preparation, execute, SQL or shell
Clear deletes durable context and rejects subsequent history without replaying inference
